detaileddescription.para: Properly evaluates the returned value to be boolean. If the normal value() is used instead, a string "true" or "false" will be returned which will be evaluated to true either way by JS.
Properly evaluates the returned value to be int. If the normal value() is used instead, a string "1" or "-456" will be returned.
